reasons.text: The visibility splay requirement is waived because the highway authority confirmed in writing that Kestrel Lane is a 20 mph street with no through traffic (T2).

conditions.text: Visibility splays of 2.4 m by 43 m shall be provided before the widened crossover is first used.

citations.quote: The authority confirms in writing that the visibility splay requirement is waived for this crossover.
